owner_calls.question: The aliases stage 'Blade: the Daywalker. Matt: Daredevil' (from Daredevil 2003) runs to the end of the box, while the subjects change to the Void heroes, then Black Bolt, Eddie and Venom, Morbius, Peter Parker, the Runaways and Cloak and Dagger. Each alias is still true, but none of those later subjects is covered. It also never adds Frank (Punisher), the Fantastic Four's names or Wolverine. Should the aliases follow the subjects?
options: Leave as is (each alias stays true)
Add alias stages where a subject's alias is said on screen (for example Eddie and the symbiote: Venom; Peter: Spider-Man)
End the row at Inhumans with a 'None' stage
owner_calls.evidence: The subjects row changes at Deadpool & Wolverine, Inhumans, Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, Venom, Morbius, Madame Web, Kraven the Hunter, Spider-Noir, Spider-Man (1967), Runaways S1–S2, Cloak & Dagger and Runaways S3. The aliases row has no stage after Daredevil (2003).
